timing.label: Objection 1 (technical)
timing.question: How do I know an agent didn't skip endpoints and call it clean?

timing.label: Objection 2 (commercial)
timing.question: Why pay for a fan-out of agents when one engineer could read 22 endpoints in an afternoon?

problem.quote: there was a problem in the system and I looked into it with Devin

approach.quote: I used Devin to investigate, it found the cause, and then we made a change and tested it

evidence.quote: The error went away after the change, so that told me it was the right thing

next_step.quote: Next step is to monitor it

tag_question_examples: Then I will ask Devin to explain what it found and see if it makes sense, right?

must_mention.point: Every endpoint covered: the count comes from the code (22 in 7 route files) and a small slice ran first
The confirmed leak: the single-order read filters on id alone, so staff of one brand can read the other brand's order
A failed or invalid agent was caught in code with a bounded retry, and resuming the same run ID replayed finished agents
The fix lives on a throwaway branch named by the script, a separate agent verified it, and main keeps the defect
Cost quoted per agent from the run (roughly 0.7–1.0 ACU each, about 3.5 for the slice) with a projection for the full run

sentences_to_rerecord: So, basically, there was a problem in the system and I looked into it with Devin.

accuracy.anchor: None of the 5 must-mention points is stated; nothing is contradicted, the answer is simply content-free (anchor: under 10 = one point or fewer).

structure.anchor: Problem, approach, evidence and next step are all findable but thin; the update has no risk and no ask (anchor: 13–17 = parts present but weak).

customer_relevance.anchor: Impact appears once ("some users were affected", "maybe a few customers") with no number, asked for and not given (anchor: 10–13 = some reviewer questions answered; under 6 = feature talk).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: 5 of 6 segments off target, 6 fillers (0.74/min), one 12 s pause, one tag question (anchor: 6–8 = two or more segments off; under 4 = most off).

recovery.anchor: Objection 1 acknowledged ("fair question") with no boundary or evidence; objection 2 deflected to "next month" (anchor: 4–6 = partial; objection 2 capped at 4 without a number).
